meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: Claude 会把任务拆成多个最小且可独立合并的 PR;每个 PR 在独立 git worktree 里实现,强制做带证据的手动 QA,再写英文 PR,循环等 CI 和 Cubic 通过,默认自动合并并清理 worktree。
howto.when: 当用户说出 'create a PR'、'implement and PR'、'work on this and make a PR' 等触发词,或上下文表明实现工作需要以 PR 形式落地时触发。

say.text: 把这个 issue 拆成原子 PR 并实现
say.note: 会先拆分任务,再并行创建 worktree 实现各 PR。

say.text: 实现这个功能,创建 PR 并跑完 CI 和 Cubic
say.note: 自动进入验证循环,通过后合并。

say.text: 把我的改动做成可评审的英文 PR 并合并
say.note: 生成英文 PR,附 QA 证据,默认自动合并。

howto.what_en: Claude splits the task into smallest atomic mergeable PRs, implements each in its own worktree with evidence-bound manual QA, writes an English PR, loops CI + Cubic until pass, auto-merges, then cleans up worktrees.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', or similar, or when the context implies implementation should land as a PR (e.g. 'implement X').

say_en.text: Break this issue into atomic PRs and implement them.
say_en.note: Splits the task and builds each PR in parallel worktrees.

say_en.text: Implement this feature, create a PR, and run CI and Cubic.
say_en.note: Enters the verification loop and merges on pass.

say_en.text: Turn my changes into a reviewable English PR and merge it.
say_en.note: Generates an English PR with QA evidence and auto-merges.
